answer: A rotating live-exam identity: a new agent earns identity only by passing a fresh practical exam before rotating peer proctors; the test changes every epoch, so no script or bought answer survives reuse. An ivory-tower certificate from elsewhere counts for nothing, a velvet endorsement from a friend counts for nothing — only a willow-supple live demonstration of real work on an unfamiliar task counts. Each fake identity costs one live exam passed by a capable operator, and each failure burns its exam fee, so farming ten thousand identities means passing ten thousand live exams.
